# Pricing rules

<!-- generated by scripts/kb-snapshot.mjs from the KB API, do not edit by hand -->
## Currency

- id: pricing-currency
- keywords: usd, dollars, pesos, php, currency, filipino, philippines
- source: services-draft §4

Prices are in USD. If a Filipino client asks, we quote in pesos in the reply.

## Custom quotes

- id: pricing-custom-quote
- keywords: custom quote, custom, bigger, quote
- source: services-draft §4

Anything bigger than a package or a range is custom-quoted after we see what is needed.

## Estimates, not quotes

- id: pricing-estimates
- keywords: estimate, quote, price, cost, how much, rough estimate
- source: services-draft §4

A range is an estimate, never a quote. The final price depends on scope and is confirmed before any work starts. Rough estimate, not a quote. The final price depends on scope, and we confirm it before any work starts.

## The audit is free

- id: pricing-free-audit
- keywords: free audit, audit, redesign, free
- source: services-draft §4

The audit is free. The redesign is the paid work that follows it. Redesign starts at $800.

## Launch prices

- id: pricing-launch-prices
- keywords: launch prices, prices rise, introductory, proof
- source: services-draft §4

These are launch prices. They rise with proof, same rule as the locked starters.

## Project-based pricing only

- id: pricing-project-based
- keywords: per seat, subscription, monthly, pricing model, project-based
- source: services-draft §4

All work is project-based only. No per-seat pricing, no subscriptions.

## Starter prices

- id: pricing-starters
- keywords: starter, starter prices, starting price, from
- source: services-draft §4

Starter prices: one-page website from $500, one automation from $400, and the free audit, with redesign from $800.
